title: Maps from bounded projective complexes are represented by chain maps
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded-above complex of projective objects. For every complex $E^\bullet$, the canonical map from morphisms $P^\bullet\to E^\bullet$ in the homotopy category to morphisms $Q(P^\bullet)\to Q(E^\bullet)$ in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is bijective.
